Server API

group GENERIC_LOCATION_SERVER_API

Function declarations for server-side API of generic location models.

Functions

bool generic_location_server_reg(uint8_t element_index, mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info)

Register a generic location server model.

Parameters:

  • element_index -- [in] Element index where the model is registered.

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to the generic location server model context.

Return values:

  • true -- Registration successful.

  • false -- Registration failed due to invalid element index or model context.

Returns:

Registration status.

bool generic_location_setup_server_reg(uint8_t element_index, mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info)

Register a generic location setup server model.

Parameters:

  • element_index -- [in] Element index where the model is registered.

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to the generic location setup server model context.

Return values:

  • true -- Registration successful.

  • false -- Registration failed due to invalid context or element.

Returns:

Registration status.

double generic_location_latitude_global_to_x(int32_t latitude_g)

Convert latitude based on WGS84 to a latitude x value in the range [-90, 90].

Parameters:

latitude_g -- [in] Global latitude based on WGS84 datum.

Returns:

Latitude x in the range [-90, 90].

int32_t generic_location_latitude_x_to_global(double latitude_x)

Convert latitude x in the range [-90, 90] to latitude based on WGS84.

Parameters:

latitude_x -- [in] Latitude value in the range of [-90, 90].

Returns:

Converted latitude value based on WGS84 datum.

double generic_location_longitude_global_to_x(int32_t longitude_g)

Convert longitude based on WGS84 to longitude x in the range [-180, 180].

Parameters:

longitude_g -- [in] Global longitude based on WGS84 datum.

Returns:

Converted longitude x in the range of [-180, 180].

int32_t generic_location_longitude_x_to_global(double longitude_x)

Convert longitude x to longitude based on WGS84.

Parameters:

longitude_x -- [in] Longitude value in the range of [-180, 180].

Returns:

Converted longitude value based on WGS84 datum.

double generic_location_update_time_to_seconds(uint8_t update_time)

Convert update time unit to seconds.

Parameters:

update_time -- [in] Update time value to be converted (0-15).

Returns:

Converted time in a range from 0.125 to 4096 seconds.

uint8_t generic_location_seconds_to_update_time(double seconds)

Convert seconds to update time format.

Parameters:

seconds -- [in] Time in seconds to be converted (0.125-4096).

Returns:

Converted time in update time format (0-15).

double generic_location_precision_to_meters(uint8_t precision)

Convert precision value to meters.

Parameters:

precision -- [in] Precision value to be converted (0-15).

Returns:

Converted precision in meters.

uint8_t generic_location_meters_to_precision(double meters)

Convert meters to precision format.

Parameters:

meters -- [in] Precision as distance in meters (0.125-4096).

Returns:

Converted precision value (0-15).

mesh_msg_send_cause_t generic_location_global_publish(const mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info, generic_location_global_t global)

Publish global location data.

Parameters:

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to the generic location server model context.

  • global -- [in] Structure containing the global location data.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Publish operation successful.

  • Others -- Publish operation encountered an error.

Returns:

Status of the publish operation.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t generic_location_local_publish(const mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info, generic_location_local_t local)

Publish local location data.

Parameters:

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to the generic location server model context.

  • local -- [in] Structure containing the local location data to be published.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Publish operation was successful.

  • Others -- Publish operation encountered an error.

Returns:

Status of the publish operation.

void generic_location_period_pub_enable(bool global, bool local)

Enable or disable periodic publishing of location data.

Parameters:

  • global -- [in] Enable or disable periodic publishing for global location.

  • local -- [in] Enable or disable periodic publishing for local location.
